headline: Shift-clicking vendor items now opens an improved quantity prompt with minus, plus, and Max buttons.

entries.title: Vendor quantity prompt with plus, minus, and Max
entries.details: Shift-clicking an item at a vendor opens an interactive quantity prompt featuring minus, plus, and Max buttons. The field starts with a single purchase amount, prevents invalid quantities, and accurately calculates the maximum you can afford across gold, cost items, and currencies.
